arithmetic.upstream_file_rows: TDC 110,404 + NCATS 23,994 + OpenADMET 139,770 = 274,168; OpenADMET and cross-source overlap prevent a unique-observation interpretation.

tier_policy.regulatory_evidence: DailyMed candidate evidence is now versioned and section/table indexed, but remains product-level regulatory evidence until each numerical claim is normalized and human-reviewed.
tier_policy.systemic_pk: CL, t1/2, AUC, Cmax, Tmax, Vd/Vdss, and F only when endpoint, units, species, route, matrix, dose, time basis, provenance, and molecule mapping are resolved.
tier_policy.upstream_adme: Solubility, permeability, protein binding, CYP/transporter effects, metabolic stability, and in-vitro intrinsic clearance remain separate mechanistic endpoints.
